rule: Per hit, in order: filters and miss, absorb/block, crit roll (crit sets the camera jolt timer and rumble on non-hero targets), overhit and miss multipliers, floating number added before HP changes, HP applied, after-effects, then if damage > 0: hit sound gated by the per-creature hit cooldown, poise roll (crit bypasses poise), and the hit state entered only when the cooldown has ended and the creature is not stunned or poised. Knockback is a per-frame speed from a power post-effect, one active at a time, moving the target through the collision grid and blocking its own walking. The camera jolt is a random per-axis offset within a fixed strength for the timer's length.
keep: Floating number is added before HP changes, so the number lands on the hit frame
Crit bypasses poise and always flinches
Camera jolt only when the target is an enemy, never on the player
Hit sound and hit state gated by a per-creature cooldown
Floating labels pushed up when they overlap
One knockback effect active at a time; a second one is dropped
change: Engine emits one ordered HitEvent; the client does the jolt, text, sound and animation
Knockback position is decided by the server; the client only tweens to it
Jolt randomness uses a seeded client RNG so the fight record does not drift
Knockback lock is per target window so three attackers give one push, not a stack
Knockback is one engine field, not a power post-effect plumbing
look_test: Ten-second clip, three attackers on one target at the fight camera, 375 wide. Three taps: A one jolt per tick with cooldown sound and one push per window; B no jolt (control); C a jolt and push on every hit. Dom judges which reads as one clear hit at a time. Publish via the look-test /preview/ flag; no release rows.
